record.field: Standard BPMN workflow for tabletop exercises with discussion phases

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> <definitions xmlns="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:omgdc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:omgdi="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" targetNamespace="http://bcm.platform/bpmn" id="TabletopExerciseDefinition">
<process id="tabletop_exercise" name="Tabletop Exercise Workflow" isExecutable="true">
<!-- Start Event --> <startEvent id="exercise_start" name="Exercise Started"> <outgoing>flow_to_briefing</outgoing> </startEvent>
<!-- Participant Briefing --> <userTask id="participant_briefing" name="Participant Briefing"> <documentation>Brief participants on exercise scenario and objectives</documentation> <incoming>flow_to_briefing</incoming> <outgoing>flow_to_scenario</outgoing> </userTask>
<!-- Scenario Presentation --> <userTask id="scenario_presentation" name="Present Scenario"> <documentation>Present the exercise scenario to participants</documentation> <incoming>flow_to_scenario</incoming> <outgoing>flow_to_discussion</outgoing> </userTask>
<!-- Discussion Phase --> <userTask id="discussion_phase" name="Discussion Phase"> <documentation>Facilitate discussion of response strategies</documentation> <incoming>flow_to_discussion</incoming> <outgoing>flow_to_decisions</outgoing> </userTask>
<!-- Decision Making --> <userTask id="decision_making" name="Decision Making"> <documentation>Make key decisions and document rationale</documentation> <incoming>flow_to_decisions</incoming> <outgoing>flow_to_evaluation</outgoing> </userTask>
<!-- Exercise Evaluation --> <userTask id="exercise_evaluation" name="Exercise Evaluation"> <documentation>Evaluate exercise performance and capture lessons learned</documentation> <incoming>flow_to_evaluation</incoming> <outgoing>flow_to_report</outgoing> </userTask>
<!-- Generate Report --> <serviceTask id="generate_report" name="Generate Exercise Report"> <documentation>Automatically generate exercise report</documentation> <incoming>flow_to_report</incoming> <outgoing>flow_to_end</outgoing> </serviceTask>
<!-- End Event --> <endEvent id="exercise_complete" name="Exercise Completed"> <incoming>flow_to_end</incoming> </endEvent>
<!-- Sequence Flows --> <sequenceFlow id="flow_to_briefing" sourceRef="exercise_start" targetRef="participant_briefing"/> <sequenceFlow id="flow_to_scenario" sourceRef="participant_briefing" targetRef="scenario_presentation"/> <sequenceFlow id="flow_to_discussion" sourceRef="scenario_presentation" targetRef="discussion_phase"/> <sequenceFlow id="flow_to_decisions" sourceRef="discussion_phase" targetRef="decision_making"/> <sequenceFlow id="flow_to_evaluation" sourceRef="decision_making" targetRef="exercise_evaluation"/> <sequenceFlow id="flow_to_report" sourceRef="exercise_evaluation" targetRef="generate_report"/> <sequenceFlow id="flow_to_end" sourceRef="generate_report" targetRef="exercise_complete"/>
</process> </definitions>
Complex BPMN workflow for full-scale exercises with simulation integration

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> <definitions xmlns="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" targetNamespace="http://bcm.platform/bpmn" id="FullScaleExerciseDefinition">
<process id="fullscale_exercise" name="Full-Scale Exercise Workflow" isExecutable="true">
<startEvent id="exercise_start" name="Exercise Started"/>
<!-- Initialize Simulation --> <serviceTask id="initialize_simulation" name="Initialize JaamSim"> <documentation>Initialize JaamSim simulation engine</documentation> </serviceTask>
<!-- Participant Setup --> <parallelGateway id="setup_parallel" name="Parallel Setup"/>
<!-- Parallel Briefings --> <userTask id="ic_briefing" name="Incident Commander Briefing"/> <userTask id="ops_briefing" name="Operations Chief Briefing"/> <userTask id="tech_briefing" name="Technical Team Briefing"/>
<parallelGateway id="setup_complete" name="Setup Complete"/>
<!-- Exercise Execution --> <userTask id="scenario_inject_1" name="Initial Scenario Inject"> <documentation>Deliver first scenario inject to participants</documentation> </userTask>
<!-- Decision Point --> <exclusiveGateway id="escalation_check" name="Escalation Required?"/>
<!-- Normal Response Path --> <userTask id="standard_response" name="Standard Response Procedures"/>
<!-- Escalated Response Path --> <userTask id="escalated_response" name="Escalated Response Procedures"/> <serviceTask id="external_notifications" name="Send External Notifications"/>
<!-- Convergence --> <exclusiveGateway id="response_convergence" name="Response Complete"/>
<!-- Simulation Monitoring --> <serviceTask id="collect_metrics" name="Collect Simulation Metrics"> <documentation>Collect real-time metrics from JaamSim</documentation> </serviceTask>
<!-- Hot Wash --> <userTask id="hot_wash" name="Hot Wash Discussion"> <documentation>Immediate post-exercise discussion</documentation> </userTask>
<!-- Report Generation --> <serviceTask id="generate_detailed_report" name="Generate Detailed Report"/>
<endEvent id="exercise_complete" name="Exercise Completed"/>
<!-- Flows --> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="exercise_start" targetRef="initialize_simulation"/> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="initialize_simulation" targetRef="setup_parallel"/>
<sequenceFlow sourceRef="setup_parallel" targetRef="ic_briefing"/> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="setup_parallel" targetRef="ops_briefing"/> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="setup_parallel" targetRef="tech_briefing"/>
<sequenceFlow sourceRef="ic_briefing" targetRef="setup_complete"/> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="ops_briefing" targetRef="setup_complete"/> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="tech_briefing" targetRef="setup_complete"/>
<sequenceFlow sourceRef="setup_complete" targetRef="scenario_inject_1"/> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="scenario_inject_1" targetRef="escalation_check"/>
<!-- Conditional flows --> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="escalation_check" targetRef="standard_response"> <conditionExpression>#{severity <= 3}</conditionExpression> </sequenceFlow> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="escalation_check" targetRef="escalated_response"> <conditionExpression>#{severity > 3}</conditionExpression> </sequenceFlow>
<sequenceFlow sourceRef="standard_response" targetRef="response_convergence"/> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="escalated_response" targetRef="external_notifications"/> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="external_notifications" targetRef="response_convergence"/>
<sequenceFlow sourceRef="response_convergence" targetRef="collect_metrics"/> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="collect_metrics" targetRef="hot_wash"/> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="hot_wash" targetRef="generate_detailed_report"/> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="generate_detailed_report" targetRef="exercise_complete"/>
</process> </definitions>
Real incident response BPMN workflow with escalation

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> <definitions xmlns="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" targetNamespace="http://bcm.platform/bpmn" id="IncidentResponseDefinition">
<process id="incident_response" name="Incident Response Workflow" isExecutable="true">
<startEvent id="incident_detected" name="Incident Detected"/>
<!-- Initial Assessment --> <userTask id="initial_assessment" name="Initial Impact Assessment"> <documentation>Assess incident severity and potential impact</documentation> </userTask>
<!-- Severity Gateway --> <exclusiveGateway id="severity_gateway" name="Incident Severity?"/>
<!-- Low Severity Path --> <userTask id="standard_response" name="Standard Response"/> <userTask id="monitor_situation" name="Monitor Situation"/>
<!-- High Severity Path --> <userTask id="activate_bcm_team" name="Activate BCM Team"/> <userTask id="crisis_communication" name="Crisis Communication"/>
<!-- Parallel Response Activities --> <parallelGateway id="parallel_response" name="Parallel Response"/> <userTask id="technical_response" name="Technical Response"/> <userTask id="business_continuity" name="Business Continuity Activation"/> <userTask id="stakeholder_communication" name="Stakeholder Communication"/> <parallelGateway id="response_convergence" name="Response Convergence"/>
<!-- External Notifications --> <serviceTask id="notify_authorities" name="Notify Authorities"/> <serviceTask id="notify_media" name="Media Communication"/>
<!-- Resolution --> <userTask id="incident_resolution" name="Incident Resolution"/> <userTask id="post_incident_review" name="Post-Incident Review"/>
<endEvent id="incident_resolved" name="Incident Resolved"/>
<!-- Sequence Flows --> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="incident_detected" targetRef="initial_assessment"/> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="initial_assessment" targetRef="severity_gateway"/>
<!-- Conditional flows based on severity --> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="severity_gateway" targetRef="standard_response"> <conditionExpression>#{severity <= 2}</conditionExpression> </sequenceFlow> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="severity_gateway" targetRef="activate_bcm_team"> <conditionExpression>#{severity > 2}</conditionExpression> </sequenceFlow>
<!-- Low severity path --> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="standard_response" targetRef="monitor_situation"/> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="monitor_situation" targetRef="incident_resolution"/>
<!-- High severity path --> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="activate_bcm_team" targetRef="crisis_communication"/> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="crisis_communication" targetRef="parallel_response"/>
<sequenceFlow sourceRef="parallel_response" targetRef="technical_response"/> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="parallel_response" targetRef="business_continuity"/> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="parallel_response" targetRef="stakeholder_communication"/>
<sequenceFlow sourceRef="technical_response" targetRef="response_convergence"/> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="business_continuity" targetRef="response_convergence"/> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="stakeholder_communication" targetRef="response_convergence"/>
<sequenceFlow sourceRef="response_convergence" targetRef="notify_authorities"/> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="notify_authorities" targetRef="incident_resolution"/>
<sequenceFlow sourceRef="incident_resolution" targetRef="post_incident_review"/> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="post_incident_review" targetRef="incident_resolved"/>
</process> </definitions>
ISO 22301 compliance audit workflow with automated checks

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> <definitions xmlns="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" targetNamespace="http://bcm.platform/bpmn" id="ComplianceAuditDefinition">
<process id="compliance_audit" name="Compliance Audit Workflow" isExecutable="true">
<startEvent id="audit_initiated" name="Audit Initiated"/>
<!-- Audit Planning --> <userTask id="audit_planning" name="Audit Planning"> <documentation>Plan audit scope, criteria, and timeline</documentation> </userTask>
<!-- Automated Compliance Check --> <serviceTask id="automated_compliance_check" name="Automated Compliance Check"> <documentation>Run automated ISO 22301 compliance checks</documentation> </serviceTask>
<!-- Document Review --> <userTask id="document_review" name="Document Review"> <documentation>Review BCM policies, procedures, and plans</documentation> </userTask>
<!-- Parallel Evidence Collection --> <parallelGateway id="evidence_collection_start"/> <userTask id="interview_stakeholders" name="Interview Stakeholders"/> <userTask id="review_records" name="Review Records"/> <userTask id="observe_processes" name="Observe Processes"/> <parallelGateway id="evidence_collection_end"/>
<!-- Gap Analysis --> <serviceTask id="gap_analysis" name="Automated Gap Analysis"> <documentation>AI-powered gap analysis against ISO 22301</documentation> </serviceTask>
<!-- Findings Documentation --> <userTask id="document_findings" name="Document Findings"> <documentation>Document audit findings and observations</documentation> </userTask>
<!-- Report Generation --> <serviceTask id="generate_audit_report" name="Generate Audit Report"> <documentation>Auto-generate comprehensive audit report</documentation> </serviceTask>
<!-- Corrective Actions --> <userTask id="plan_corrective_actions" name="Plan Corrective Actions"> <documentation>Plan corrective actions for identified gaps</documentation> </userTask>
<endEvent id="audit_complete" name="Audit Complete"/>
<!-- Sequence Flows --> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="audit_initiated" targetRef="audit_planning"/> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="audit_planning" targetRef="automated_compliance_check"/> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="automated_compliance_check" targetRef="document_review"/> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="document_review" targetRef="evidence_collection_start"/>
<sequenceFlow sourceRef="evidence_collection_start" targetRef="interview_stakeholders"/> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="evidence_collection_start" targetRef="review_records"/> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="evidence_collection_start" targetRef="observe_processes"/>
<sequenceFlow sourceRef="interview_stakeholders" targetRef="evidence_collection_end"/> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="review_records" targetRef="evidence_collection_end"/> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="observe_processes" targetRef="evidence_collection_end"/>
<sequenceFlow sourceRef="evidence_collection_end" targetRef="gap_analysis"/> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="gap_analysis" targetRef="document_findings"/> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="document_findings" targetRef="generate_audit_report"/> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="generate_audit_report" targetRef="plan_corrective_actions"/> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="plan_corrective_actions" targetRef="audit_complete"/>
</process> </definitions>
Comprehensive BIA workflow with AI-powered analysis
Generate comprehensive Business Impact Analysis workflow for the given business context, including process identification, impact assessment, and recovery objectives calculation.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> <definitions xmlns="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" targetNamespace="http://bcm.platform/bpmn" id="BIAWorkflowDefinition">
<process id="bia_workflow" name="Business Impact Analysis Workflow" isExecutable="true">
<startEvent id="bia_initiated" name="BIA Initiated"/>
<!-- Business Process Identification --> <userTask id="identify_processes" name="Identify Business Processes"> <documentation>Identify and catalog critical business processes</documentation> </userTask>
<!-- AI-Powered Impact Analysis --> <serviceTask id="ai_impact_analysis" name="AI Impact Analysis"> <documentation>Use AI to analyze potential business impacts</documentation> </serviceTask>
<!-- Stakeholder Impact Assessment --> <userTask id="stakeholder_impact" name="Assess Stakeholder Impact"> <documentation>Evaluate impact on stakeholders and dependencies</documentation> </userTask>
<!-- RTO/RPO Calculation --> <serviceTask id="calculate_objectives" name="Calculate RTO/RPO"> <documentation>Calculate Recovery Time and Point Objectives</documentation> </serviceTask>
<!-- Validation Gateway --> <exclusiveGateway id="validation_required" name="Validation Required?"/>
<!-- Management Review --> <userTask id="management_review" name="Management Review"> <documentation>Senior management review of BIA results</documentation> </userTask>
<!-- BIA Report Generation --> <serviceTask id="generate_bia_report" name="Generate BIA Report"> <documentation>Auto-generate comprehensive BIA report</documentation> </serviceTask>
<endEvent id="bia_complete" name="BIA Complete"/>
<!-- Sequence Flows --> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="bia_initiated" targetRef="identify_processes"/> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="identify_processes" targetRef="ai_impact_analysis"/> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="ai_impact_analysis" targetRef="stakeholder_impact"/> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="stakeholder_impact" targetRef="calculate_objectives"/> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="calculate_objectives" targetRef="validation_required"/>
<sequenceFlow sourceRef="validation_required" targetRef="management_review"> <conditionExpression>#{high_impact == true}</conditionExpression> </sequenceFlow> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="validation_required" targetRef="generate_bia_report"> <conditionExpression>#{high_impact == false}</conditionExpression> </sequenceFlow>
<sequenceFlow sourceRef="management_review" targetRef="generate_bia_report"/> <sequenceFlow sourceRef="generate_bia_report" targetRef="bia_complete"/>
</process> </definitions>
